source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical Calendar patch avoids double handling by skipping mid, mailto, news and snews links for the MailLink actor, and removes its old URL allowlist. Review reports mailto/mid success while the author says file-link sanitization still needs separate work. The fixed dispatcher narrows the skip to content browsing contexts and restores direct mid handling elsewhere. Preserve that ownership boundary; the old unconditional skip is not a rule for every Calendar caller, and no arbitrary-protocol success or safety was tested.
title: Keep Calendar link routing tied to the MailLink actor context
